const travel = $node["Code"].json;

// Calculate the number of days between startDate and endDate
const startDate = new Date(travel.startDate);
const endDate = new Date(travel.endDate);
const timeDiff = endDate - startDate;
const days = Math.ceil(timeDiff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1;

// Generate daily activities for Turks & Caicos
let dailyActivities = '';

// Day 1: Arrival and light activities
dailyActivities += `### Day 1: Arrival in Turks & Caicos (July 1)
` +
  `- **Morning**: Flight from ${travel.departureLocation} to Providenciales (PLS).
` +
  `- **Afternoon**: Check into your hotel near Grace Bay Beach.
` +
  `- **Evening**: Dinner at a local restaurant like Coco Bistro. 🍽️ [Reservation](https://cocobistro.tc/)

`;

// Day 2: Beach Relaxation
dailyActivities += `### Day 2: Beach Relaxation (July 2)
` +
  `- **Morning**: Relax at Grace Bay Beach, one of the world's best beaches. 🌊
` +
  `- **Afternoon**: Lunch at Somewhere Café and Lounge. 🍽️ [Menu](https://somewherecafeandlounge.com/)
` +
  `- **Evening**: Enjoy nightlife at Danny Buoy's. 🎶 [Info](https://www.dannybuoys.com/)

`;

// Day 3: Snorkeling Adventure
dailyActivities += `### Day 3: Snorkeling Adventure (July 3)
` +
  `- **Morning**: Book a snorkeling tour to the Turks & Caicos Barrier Reef. 🏄‍♂️ [Tour Info](https://www.dive.tc/)
` +
  `- **Afternoon**: Continue relaxing at Grace Bay Beach.
` +
  `- **Evening**: Attend a local music event in Providenciales. 🎶

`;

// Day 4: Island Excursion
dailyActivities += `### Day 4: Island Excursion (July 4)
` +
  `- **Morning**: Take an island-hopping excursion to North Caicos and Middle Caicos. 🚤 [Tour Info](https://www.turksandcaicostourism.com/island-hopping/)
` +
  `- **Afternoon**: Visit Mudjin Harbour for stunning views.
` +
  `- **Evening**: Beach bonfire at your hotel. 🔥

`;

// Day 5: Adventure Sports
dailyActivities += `### Day 5: Adventure Sports (July 5)
` +
  `- **Morning**: Go kiteboarding or paddleboarding at Long Bay Beach. 🪂 [Booking](https://www.kiteprovo.com/)
` +
  `- **Afternoon**: Relax at Sapodilla Bay, a quieter beach spot.
` +
  `- **Evening**: Fine dining at Infiniti Restaurant. 🍽️ [Reservation](https://infinitirestaurant.com/)

`;

// Day 6: Departure
dailyActivities += `### Day 6: Departure (July 6)
` +
  `- **Morning**: Spend your final morning relaxing at Grace Bay Beach. 🌊
` +
  `- **Afternoon**: Check out of your hotel and catch your flight back to ${travel.departureLocation}.
`;

// Generate the itinerary in the requested format
let itinerary = `🌍 Trip Plan: ${travel.destination}
` +
  `(${travel.startDate} to ${travel.endDate})
` +
  `📍 Departure Location: ${travel.departureLocation}

` +
  `💸 Budget: $${travel.budget} (for ${travel.groupSize} people)

` +
  `✈️ Flights
` +
  `**Departure City:** ${travel.departureLocation}
` +
  `**Airlines:** Delta, American Airlines, Air France
` +
  `**Estimated Cost:** ~ depends on location
` +
  `**Tips:** Book 3-4 months early, check direct or 1-stop flights

` +
  `🏨 Accommodation
` +
  `**Example:** Hotel near Grace Bay Beach
` +
  `**Cost:** $200–$400 per night
` +
  `**Tip:** Consider boutique hotels or resorts for a luxurious experience
` +
  `[Book Hotels](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?dest_id=-2621515&dest_type=city)

` +
  `📆 Daily Activities
` +
  `${dailyActivities}

` +
  `🍽️ Food Budget
` +
  `Estimate $50–$70/day per person for meals. Explore local eateries and markets.

` +
  `📊 Estimated Cost Summary
` +
  `**Category** | **Cost**
` +
  `Flights | ~
` +
  `Accommodation | ~
` +
  `Activities | ~
` +
  `Food | ~
` +
  `**Total** | ~

` +
  `💡 Travel Tips
` +
  `- 🚌 Consider renting a car for flexibility
` +
  `- 🌦️ Pack for warm, sunny weather with occasional rain
` +
  `- 🗣️ English is widely spoken, but a friendly "hello" goes a long way
` +
  `- 🔐 Watch out for common tourist scams
` +
  `- ✨ Enjoy your personalized adventure!

` +
  `This itinerary was automatically created by your AI Travel Agent powered by ChatGPT
`;

return [{
  json: {
    destination: travel.destination,
    departureLocation: travel.departureLocation,
    startDate: travel.startDate,
    endDate: travel.endDate,
    groupSize: travel.groupSize,
    budget: travel.budget,
    tripType: travel.tripType,
    ageRange: travel.ageRange,
    dayActivity: travel.dayActivity,
    nightActivity: travel.nightActivity,
    email: travel.email,
    itinerary: itinerary
  }
}];
